hints.title: Exploit Sorted Order
hints.text: The array is non-decreasing. An element appearing strictly more than a quarter of the time must span an offset span.

hints.title: Check Quarter Interval Jump
hints.text: Let span = floor(n / 4). If arr[i] == arr[i + span], that value appears more than 25% of the time.

hints.title: Linear Scan with Offset
hints.text: Iterate i from 0 up to n - span - 1; when arr[i] matches arr[i + span], immediately return arr[i].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full frequency tables use extra space when a simple interval check on the sorted array suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scanning with a fixed offset of floor(N / 4) uses constant auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate leverages sortedness to check offset elements in O(N) or O(log N) time.
complexity.notes: Can also check quarter quartile candidates at indices N/4, N/2, 3N/4 using binary search.
